name: Switzerland
visaRequirements: Schengen visa rules apply for many travelers; check current requirements before booking
bestExperience: Best experience: hiking around Oeschinensee — the most beautiful lake I've ever seen (go on a sunny day if you can).

about.description: Switzerland offers dramatic alpine scenery, pristine lakes, and charming villages. It is a dream destination for short mountain escapes and outdoor adventures.
highlights: A breathtaking Alpine landscape around Lauterbrunnen and Interlaken
Iconic peaks and glacier lakes in the Bernese Oberland
Efficient scenic trains and well-marked hiking trails
Swiss chocolate, cheese, and refined hospitality

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: June to September for hiking and lake activities; December to March for winter sports
transportation: Swiss trains are punctual and scenic
Public transport covers most mountain villages
Car rentals are useful for flexibility in remote areas
culturalNotes: Swiss etiquette values punctuality and quiet public behavior
Tipping is modest but appreciated for great service
Try local specialties like fondue, raclette, and rösti
